entries.heading: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITY TO PROVIDE TEMPORARY INCREASE IN RATES OF BASIC ALLOWANCE FOR HOUSING UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES
ancestors: TITLE VI—COMPENSATION AND OTHER PERSONNEL BENEFITS
entries.text:
SEC. 603. EXTENSION OF AUTHORITY TO PROVIDE TEMPORARY INCREASE IN 
                        RATES OF BASIC ALLOWANCE FOR HOUSING UNDER 
                        CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES.

    Section 403(b)(7)(E) of title 37, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``December 31, 2016'' and inserting ``December 31, 2017''.
